description: This file defines the onboarding user interface for an Android app using Jetpack Compose. It manages the onboarding flow, including gateway setup (via QR code or manual input), permission requests, and connection verification. It contains composable functions that render various steps of onboarding, handles permissions, user interactions, and communicates with a ViewModel for state management.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: Enum representing the stages of the onboarding flow: Welcome, Gateway setup, Permissions, and Final check.

classes.name: GatewayInputMode
classes.description: Enum indicating whether the user is inputting gateway info via setup code or Manual entry.

classes.name: PermissionToggle
classes.description: Enum for various permissions that the user can enable or disable during onboarding.

classes.name: SpecialAccessToggle
classes.description: Enum for special system access toggles, e.g., NotificationListener.

methods.name: OnboardingFlow
methods.description: Main composable function managing the entire onboarding UI flow.

methods.name: canFinishOnboarding
methods.description: Checks if onboarding can be completed based on connection states.

methods.name: onboardingPrimaryButtonColors
methods.description: Defines button color scheme for primary actions.

methods.name: onboardingTextFieldColors
methods.description: Defines color scheme for text fields.

methods.name: onboardingSwitchColors
methods.description: Defines color scheme for switches.

methods.name: StepRail
methods.description: Displays progress indicator for each onboarding step.

methods.name: WelcomeStep
methods.description: Displays the welcome information with feature highlights.

methods.name: GatewayStep
methods.description: Handles the gateway configuration UI including QR scanning, manual input, and validation.

methods.name: GuideBlock
methods.description: Displays informative blocks with title and content.

methods.name: GatewayModeToggle
methods.description: UI to switch between setup code and manual input modes.

methods.name: GatewayModeChip
methods.description: Button component representing a toggle between gateway input modes.

methods.name: QuickFillChip
methods.description: Button used for quick input presets such as Emulator or Localhost.

methods.name: ResolvedEndpoint
methods.description: Displays the resolved gateway endpoint URL.

methods.name: StepShell
methods.description: Container for each step with a title and content.

methods.name: InlineDivider
methods.description: A visual separator line.

methods.name: PermissionsStep
methods.description: Manages the UI for requesting various permissions and system access.

methods.name: PermissionSectionHeader
methods.description: Header for sections of permissions

methods.name: PermissionToggleRow
methods.description: Ui row for toggling individual permissions with status.

methods.name: FinalStep
methods.description: Shows the summary and verification of the gateway connection before finishing onboarding.

methods.name: isPermissionGranted
methods.description: Checks if a specific permission is granted in the given context.

methods.name: qrScannerErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns an error message when QR scanner cannot start.

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener access is enabled.

methods.name: openNotificationListenerSettings
methods.description: Opens system settings for notification listener access.

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Opens the application-specific settings page.

methods.name: hasMotionCapabilities
methods.description: Checks if the device has motion sensor capabilities (accelerometer or step counter).
